answer: Each identity anchors to one carrier-attested phone line: the carrier signs proof of a postpaid line with ninety days of billing history, and the network locks that proof in a shared vault, one line per identity. A farm cannot clone lines, because each line costs a monthly bill and a real SIM in a real handset; an ember of doubt is enough to trigger a fresh call-back challenge the puppet cannot answer. A puppet caught sharing a line loses its deposit and its place on the ledge of established members, while an honest user pays one bill and keeps one vote.
